changelog:
xhs-writer 1.0.0

- Initial release of an all-in-one Xiaohongshu (小红书/REDnote) content creation tool.
- Generates a complete publishing kit in one step: viral title, body copy, hashtags, first-comment hook, multi-image Markdown, and visual style parameters.
- Covers tech/AI, knowledge, lifestyle, travel, and general topics.
- Fully offline; no external tools, API, cookies, or browser required.
- Includes internal templates and style/theme libraries for dynamic, high-quality outputs.
summary: 小红书内容创作套件，离线生成爆款标题、正文、话题、评论和多卡图片Markdown，全方位支持多类型主题。
